result.summary: Deletes the obsolete `indexes/coinstats` database directory automatically on startup when `-coinstatsindex` is initialized. If the legacy directory exists, it calls `DestroyDB` and removes the folder, logging an informational message on success or a warning on failure.
result.problem: Nodes upgraded from v29 or earlier retain the superseded `indexes/coinstats` index directory on disk indefinitely, needlessly consuming disk space unless manually deleted.
evidence: PR description: 'There was a TODO in the code that scheduled the deletion for v31. Since v32 branch-off has happened, this would now ship in v33. By then 29.x should be EOL...'
result.scope_notes: Small, self-contained cleanup executing a previously scheduled TODO.
result.card: Automatically deletes the obsolete legacy coinstats index directory at indexes/coinstats on startup when -coinstatsindex is enabled. A format update in v30 moved the active index to indexes/coinstatsindex while keeping the old folder so users could downgrade to v29 without resyncing. With v29 reaching end-of-life, this scheduled cleanup executes an existing TODO to reclaim disk space on upgraded nodes.

risk.why: A bug in deletion handling could fail to clean up the legacy directory or emit an incorrect warning during node startup.
